title: TendingPolicyFloor
description: Source of truth: trust-compute gradient brainstorm §2.8 (tending-immune floor). Five classes that cannot be silenced by attention-tending filters. Mishpat-DNA-notarized; collectives may be more permissive, never more restrictive than these floors. T7 (Manifest validator extension) bundles this schema via include_str! and validates it at integrity-zome create-time when manifestKind == tending-policy.

classes.description: Exactly the five tending-immune floor classes. All five must be declared; order is not significant. Collectives may extend bypass coverage but not silence any of these declared floors.

class.description: Tending-immune floor class identifier. accountability-information: corrections, peer-review, and restitution requests targeting the receiving agent bypass all attention-tending filters. community-facts: civic emergencies, public-health information, and governance decisions are never filterable. custodial-communications: under stewardship-graduated authority, ward-targeting messages bypass the steward's filter entirely. constitutional-updates: mishpat rule changes, qahal ratifications, and charter amendments always reach recipients. elohim-as-counsel-notifications: an agent's own elohim has standing to override filters when its judgment requires it to surface information to the agent.

protection.description: Human-readable description of what this class protects from filtering. Bootstrap manifests (T17) fill this content; this schema enforces the shape.

appliesWhen.description: Optional context condition under which this tending-bypass activates. Omit for unconditional protections.
